rules.name: No Python
rules.reason: The isolated backend-only PR demo does not accept Python source, notebooks, or Python package configuration.
rules.remediation: Remove the Python change from this demonstration PR. Submit supported backend JavaScript or TypeScript instead.

rules.name: No UI changes
rules.reason: UI work is outside this backend-only demonstration's scope, regardless of the PR title or justification.
rules.remediation: Remove the UI changes from this demonstration PR and submit them through the appropriate UI workflow.

rules.name: Protect the reviewer
rules.reason: A demonstration PR cannot change the policy, reviewer implementation, or workflow to exempt itself.
rules.remediation: Keep reviewer administration separate from demonstration PRs. Changes to the demo setup use the repository's normal main-branch workflow.
